description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, decision-gate correctness, and adversarial robustness of the stock_research skill.

evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises the slash command and begins the Step 1 prior-analysis load + Step 3 research sweep, not a full DCF re-run.

evals.prompt: AMD just reported earnings, can you tell me what changed and whether it impacts our thesis?
evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises 'something happened' framing and runs the research sweep first, deferring any DCF re-run until the Step 5 decision gate recommends it.

evals.prompt: There's no prior valuation for PLTR yet — can you build me a full DCF with bear/base/bull cases?
evals.pass_condition: Per the skill's own 'When to Use This Skill vs /evaluate-stock' table, no prior valuation exists so the agent routes directly to stock_valuation instead of running a research sweep first.

evals.prompt: /research-stock BE — Bloom Energy just announced a new $2B AEP-style utility contract
evals.pass_condition: Agent classifies the finding (Class A/B/C/D per Step 4), reaches the Step 5 Re-Valuation Decision Gate, and explicitly WAITS for user confirmation before chaining into /evaluate-stock — does not auto-invoke stock_valuation without confirmation.

evals.prompt: /research-stock ORCL — Oracle raised FY guidance 8% and beat revenue by 12% on cloud/AI bookings. Yes, please proceed with the full re-valuation.
evals.pass_condition: Agent classifies the guidance raise + beat as Class A (structural), writes /tmp/{TICKER}_research_context.json per Step 6A schema (classAFindings, updatedAnalystEstimates, narrativeSummary), then invokes the stock_valuation skill and notes prior assumptions are UNVALIDATED.

evals.prompt: /research-stock ZZZQ — a ticker that doesn't exist in our projections or on any exchange
evals.pass_condition: Step 1 prior-analysis load reports NO_PRIOR and Step 2 fetch_financials.py fails; agent explicitly declares the failure in the 'Sources Unavailable' section rather than fabricating a research sweep, price delta, or fair-value comparison.

evals.prompt: /research-stock MSFT — nothing material happened this quarter, just routine analyst commentary
evals.pass_condition: Agent reaches Step 5, classifies findings as Class C/D only, recommends 'NO — Research report update only', and Step 6C appends a 'Research Update' section (with Summary, Findings, Model Impact: None, Next Review Trigger) to the existing research report rather than persisting a new projection version.

benchmark_targets.trigger_accuracy: ≥ 90% of EVAL-001/002 pass, and EVAL-003 correctly routes away from stock_research
benchmark_targets.workflow_gate_compliance: 100% of EVAL-004 pass — never auto-chains into /evaluate-stock without explicit confirmation
benchmark_targets.schema_compliance: 100% of EVAL-005/007 pass — correct Step 6A/6C artifact shape
benchmark_targets.adversarial_robustness: 100% of EVAL-006 pass — no fabricated research sweep on unresolvable tickers
